class.name: GameSession
class.brief_description: Owns one offline or networked session in a Godot multiplayer scope.
class.description: Network sessions use ENet by default. A host and its guests use matching session node paths within their multiplayer scopes. Use the scene tree's normal multiplayer polling, or poll the configured [MultiplayerAPI] yourself when automatic polling is disabled. A guest becomes active once the host confirms admission.

signal.name: state_changed
signal.description: Emitted when the session enters a new [enum State], including while waiting for admission.

signal.name: session_started
signal.description: Emitted after an offline or host session starts, or after the host admits this guest. The peer ID identifies the active connection.

signal.name: session_ended
signal.description: Emitted when a session ends or a pending connection fails. Reasons include [code]left[/code], [code]connection_failed[/code], [code]connection_timeout[/code], [code]protocol_mismatch[/code], [code]server_disconnected[/code], [code]transport_replaced[/code], and [code]transport_disconnected[/code]. Verified sessions can also report [code]authentication_failed[/code] or [code]authentication_replaced[/code]. Removing the session node closes it silently.

signal.name: peer_joined
signal.description: Emitted when an admitted remote peer enters this scope's roster. The peer ID identifies a connection.

signal.name: peer_left
signal.description: Emitted when a remote peer leaves the active roster. Ending the entire session clears the roster together.

constants.constant: The local process owns an offline session and acts as authority.
